full_prompt_en: A square impressionistic oil painting shows a wet city street at dusk, with a small red car near a row of dark and blue-painted terrace houses. A broad blue-gray sky takes the upper third, its brush texture and faint streaks making the air look rainy. Along the left half, closely spaced houses rise beneath clustered chimneys and aerials. One façade is a vivid but weathered blue, flanked by charcoal and warm gray stone fronts. A few rectangular windows glow with amber interior light, and a brighter lamp shines beside a doorway. At the middle of the road, the rounded red car stands or moves away toward the right, its vivid color reflected as a broken patch on the slick pavement. A darker car rests near the left curb. On the right side of the street, a pair of small dark figures walk along the curb toward the distance, while other pedestrians become tiny marks through the mist. Tall thin street lamps recede from the foreground right to the center; their yellow bulbs and faint reflections add a repeated rhythm. The road in the lower half is mostly pale slate and gray-blue, interrupted by dark curb lines, shallow puddles, and strokes of reflected gold. Buildings farther back dissolve into a bluish haze, so their details become softer and smaller. The paint alternates rough short marks on masonry with broad horizontal sweeps across the road and sky. Light is diffuse from the cloudy sky, while warm window and lamp light catches the wet surface in narrow streaks. The overall composition is subdued and spacious, its cool urban grays enlivened by the single warm red vehicle and scattered golden points.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形印象式油画描绘暮色中的湿城市街道，一辆小红车靠近一排深色及蓝色粉刷的联排房屋。宽阔蓝灰天空占据上方三分之一，笔触肌理和微弱条痕使空气看起来湿冷多雨。左半部，房屋紧密相接，屋顶上烟囱与天线成簇。其中一面墙是鲜明却风化的蓝色，两侧夹着炭色和暖灰色石墙。几扇长方窗透出琥珀色室内光，门旁有一处更亮的灯。道路中央附近，圆润红车停着或向右远去，鲜艳车色在湿路面上倒映为断裂色斑。左侧路边还有一辆较暗的车。街道右侧，一对小深色人影沿路边朝远处走，其他行人在薄雾中化为细小笔点。细高路灯从前景右方一直退向中央；黄色灯泡及浅淡反光构成重复节奏。下半部道路以浅石板灰和蓝灰为主，被深色路缘、浅水坑及反光金色笔触打断。更远处建筑消失进蓝雾，细节因此更软、更小。颜料在砖墙上用粗短笔痕，在道路与天空则用宽阔横向扫笔。云层天空提供漫射光，温暖的窗光和灯光在湿面上留下狭长色痕。整体构图低调而宽敞，冷灰城市色调被唯一暖红车辆和零散金色亮点激活。
style_prompt_en: This impressionistic urban oil treatment favors a cool, damp range of blue-gray, slate, charcoal, and weathered neutral color. Small warm lights and one stronger saturated accent punctuate the low-key field, then break into elongated reflections across glossy lower planes. Architectural forms remain recognizable through economical vertical strokes, while distance dissolves into mist and near surfaces carry broad horizontal brush sweeps. Edges are crisp at a few dark silhouettes and curb lines but generally soften through rain and paint texture. Diffuse overhead light supplies an even cool base; isolated warm glows add depth and focal rhythm. The composition feels spacious, reflective, and quietly lived in.
style_prompt_zh: 这种印象式城市油画处理偏向潮湿的冷色范围：蓝灰、石板色、炭色和风化中性色。少量暖光和一个更强的饱和强调打断低调底面，继而在湿亮的下方平面上碎成拉长倒影。垂直方向的节省笔触让形体仍可辨，远处却消失进薄雾，近处表面则带宽阔横扫笔迹。边缘在少数深色剪影及路缘线处清脆，整体仍因雨气和颜料肌理柔化。上方漫射光提供均匀冷色基底，孤立暖光增添纵深与焦点节奏。构图宽敞、有反光感，安静地显出生活痕迹。
theme_en: A red car on a wet gray street at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色湿街上的红色小汽车
name: Malcolm Teasdale
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
